  • Current Residential Address Proof: A recent utility bill copy or workplace business card for local security record verification.
  • Active Mobile Number & Emergency Contact: For 24/7 roadside assistance coordination.

If you are visiting Karachi from UAE, UK, USA, Canada, Saudi Arabia, or elsewhere:

  • Valid Passport with entry stamp & visa.
  • NICOP / Overseas Pakistani Card.
  • Valid International Driving Permit (IDP) or native driving license with English translation.
  • Karachi accommodation details (hotel booking or residence address).
